description: Luxury modern apartment located in the stylish Iena neighborhood next to the Golden Triangle. Spectacular views of the Eiffel Tower and the Parisian skyline. Walking distance to the Champs Elysee, Avenue Georges V, and Trocadero. Close to the famous shopping are of Avenue Montaigne. Surrounded by museums, restaurants and cafes.
